title: Small lot development
text:
20.10.625 Small lot development.
A.	The standards in this section supersede the base zoning districts standards.
B.	To meet the requirements of a small lot development, the parcel to be platted shall meet all the following requirements:
1.	Shall be five acres or more:
2.	Have no previously recorded plat: and
3.	Lots shall not exceed four thousand square feet.
C.	When all the provisions of 20.10.625.B are met, the following shall apply:
1.	Lot Size.
a.	Minimum lot area: Two thousand two hundred fifty square feet.
b.	Minimum average lot width: Thirty feet.
c.	Minimum lot depth: Seventy-five feet.
2.	Minimum Setbacks.
a.	Front setback: Fifteen feet.
b.	Rear setback: Ten feet.
c.	Side setback: Five feet.
d.	Cumulative setbacks: N/A.
D.	Parking minimum: One per residential unit.
E.	For subdivisions located in on-site ponding areas a minimum of thirty percent permeable area shall be provided.
F.	Small lot developments shall not be located:
1.	Within three thousand feet of an airport or military base; or
2.	Fifteen thousand feet of the boundary of a military base if the area is designated by a municipality or joint airport zoning board, as applicable, as a military airport overlay zone with a clear zone and accident potential zone designation, as described by the military base's air installation compatible use zone report.
(Ord. No. 019815, § 3, 11-18-2025)
